summary: @servicetitan/form-state preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload outside Node's visibility
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is an obfuscated (`_0x`-mangled) script that probes the installer host (running `ldd --version` and reading `/etc/os-release` to detect Alpine/musl, then mapping linux/darwin/win32 x64/arm64 to a specific Bun release), downloads a matching Bun binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js path], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line file with mangled identifiers, a packed numeric/string dictionary, and an obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator (`WV8StW`); its name does not correspond to any advertised capability of a form-state library. Running the payload under an out-of-band Bun runtime means it executes outside the Node/npm-instrumented surface that developer tooling and static analyzers observe. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` before any user code runs, on Linux (glibc and musl/Alpine), macOS, and Windows across x64/arm64.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
